en: Black‑and‑white view of a riverside promenade in a European spa town. Well‑dressed men and women in early 20th‑century fashion stroll along a paved walkway with a metal railing beside a shallow river lined with stone embankments. In the background stand large ornate multi‑storey spa or hotel buildings with mansard roofs and chimneys, set at the base of densely forested hills. A small bridge crosses the river in the distance.
